source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: Lili Reinhart and Tom Bateman Find Out How Well They Know Each Other

lines.en: I don't know what an FYP is.
lines.zh: 我不知道 FYP 是什麼。

lines.en: My own dog on my For You page? Probably not.
lines.zh: 我自己的狗出現在我的「為你推薦」頁面？大概不會。

lines.en: I'm not going to give you the point, but that's okay.
lines.zh: 我不會給你這一分，不過沒關係。

lines.en: See, it's not personal. I'm just an idiot.
lines.zh: 你看，這不是針對你，我只是個笨蛋。

lines.en: Lili: Hi, I'm Lili Reinhart.
lines.zh: Lili：嗨，我是 Lili Reinhart。

lines.en: Tom: And I'm Tom Bateman.
lines.zh: Tom：我是 Tom Bateman。

lines.en: We're the cast of The Love Hypothesis, and we're going to find out how well we know each other.
lines.zh: 我們是《愛情假說》的演員，要來看看我們有多了解彼此。

lines.en: Tom: I don't know you on a pen and paper level. I know you on a spiritual level.
lines.zh: Tom：我不是在紙筆層面上了解你，我是在心靈層面上了解你。

lines.en: Lili: That's what I'm saying. I don't think I exist on a pen and paper level.
lines.zh: Lili：我就是這個意思。我覺得我不存在於紙筆層面。

lines.en: Tom: I believe you when you say that.
lines.zh: Tom：你這麼說我相信。

lines.en: Favorite color? Green.
lines.zh: 最喜歡的顏色？綠色。

lines.en: I was going to say green. What's your favorite color? Blue.
lines.zh: 我正要說綠色。你最喜歡什麼顏色？藍色。

lines.en: This is going to be hilarious.
lines.zh: 這一定會很好笑。

lines.en: The first time you met each other: over Zoom. I was in New York, you were in London, and that was our chemistry read.
lines.zh: 你們第一次見面：透過 Zoom。我在紐約、你在倫敦，那是我們的對戲試鏡。

lines.en: And then in person, I think it would have been that rehearsal, and you brought your dog in.
lines.zh: 然後第一次見到本人，我想是在排練時，你把你的狗帶來了。

lines.en: Okay, so we got that one.
lines.zh: 好，這題我們答對了。

lines.en: What were our first impressions of each other?
lines.zh: 我們對彼此的第一印象是什麼？

lines.en: We just talked about this. We said we both had really good first impressions of each other.
lines.zh: 我們剛剛才聊過。我們都說對彼此的第一印象很好。

lines.en: I was like, "God, this woman is fun. I'll have a good time on this."
lines.zh: 我那時想：「天啊，這個人好有趣，拍這部片會很開心。」

lines.en: Were you guys aware of the fan fiction world?
lines.zh: 你們知道同人小說這個圈子嗎？

lines.en: I didn't when I was sent the script and told to read the book. I think I found out afterwards.
lines.zh: 收到劇本、被要求讀原著的時候還不知道，我想是後來才發現的。

lines.en: And then obviously finding out the connection between your wife and the fan fiction was crazy.
lines.zh: 後來當然發現你太太和那篇同人小說的關聯，真的很瘋狂。

lines.en: When they found out you were playing Adam, it was such a weird but amazing and, I think, very beneficial thing.
lines.zh: 當大家知道你要演 Adam，那是一件很奇妙、但很棒，而且我覺得非常有利的事。

lines.en: I knew everything about it and I campaigned hard. No, I didn't.
lines.zh: 我對這一切瞭若指掌，還拚命爭取。開玩笑的，沒有。

lines.en: I read the film, and I just really loved the film.
lines.zh: 我讀了劇本，就真的很喜歡這部片。

lines.en: I didn't realize how big it was until this moment.
lines.zh: 我直到現在才知道它有多紅。

lines.en: Your favorite rom-com.
lines.zh: 你最喜歡的愛情喜劇。

lines.en: You said Easy A. But then I changed my mind.
lines.zh: 你說過《破處女王》。但後來我改變主意了。

lines.en: Oh, The Apartment? Yes.
lines.zh: 喔，《公寓春光》？對。

lines.en: It is the first thing that I said, and then I changed it to Crazy, Stupid, Love.
lines.zh: 那是我一開始說的，後來我改成《熟男型不型》。

lines.en: The Love Hypothesis co-star they would make their emergency contact.
lines.zh: 他們會把哪位《愛情假說》的演員設為緊急聯絡人。

lines.en: Well, not you, because you have your phone on airplane mode half the time.
lines.zh: 嗯，不會是你，因為你一半的時間手機都開飛航模式。

lines.en: Do not disturb.
lines.zh: 勿擾模式。

lines.en: Once you told me that when we wrapped the movie, you were turning your phone on airplane mode for three weeks.
lines.zh: 你有一次跟我說，電影殺青後你要把手機開飛航模式三個禮拜。

lines.en: Yeah, it was delicious.
lines.zh: 對，那感覺太美妙了。

lines.en: Why would you do that?
lines.zh: 你為什麼要這麼做？

lines.en: I don't like people having access to me. That's it.
lines.zh: 我不喜歡別人隨時找得到我，就這樣。

lines.en: It's such a nice thing to do. You should try it.
lines.zh: 這真的很棒，你應該試試。

lines.en: You know he'd pick up. He would drop everything. He's so sweet.
lines.zh: 你知道他一定會接，他會放下一切，他人好好。

lines.en: Actually, do you know what? I would call you. You would sort it out.
lines.zh: 其實你知道嗎？我會打給你，你會把事情搞定。

lines.en: Star sign. Bonus point?
lines.zh: 星座。加分題？

lines.en: You have whimsy to you. I do have some whimsy.
lines.zh: 你有種異想天開的氣質。我確實有點古靈精怪。

lines.en: Your favorite scene to film in The Love Hypothesis.
lines.zh: 你在《愛情假說》裡最喜歡拍的一場戲。

lines.en: That's a good question. I think I do have one.
lines.zh: 好問題，我想我有一個。

lines.en: It was you and me, and there were some other characters in it.
lines.zh: 是你和我，還有其他幾個角色。

lines.en: Well, I already got it wrong. You did. I'm sorry. I'm a believer in second chances.
lines.zh: 嗯，我已經答錯了。你錯了，抱歉。但我相信要給第二次機會。

lines.en: The dinner party? No. Third chance is out.
lines.zh: 晚宴那場？不是。第三次機會用完了。

lines.en: I was going to say my favorite was when we're in the cafe, you and me talking, and like, "Shut up, shut up, they're coming over."
lines.zh: 我本來要說，我最喜歡的是我們在咖啡廳那場，你和我在講話，然後說：「閉嘴閉嘴，他們過來了。」

lines.en: Because they made me laugh, and I thought it was a fun thing to be stuck in the middle of.
lines.zh: 因為他們讓我笑出來，我覺得被夾在中間很好玩。

lines.en: And us sort of pretending for the first time, and I did that weird sort of kiss on your head.
lines.zh: 那是我們第一次假裝，我做了那個有點怪的親頭頂動作。

lines.en: The scene where I get the lanyard and let it go.
lines.zh: 我拿到識別證吊繩、然後放手的那場戲。

lines.en: No. Sunscreen. Sunscreen, of course.
lines.zh: 不是。擦防曬那場。當然是擦防曬那場。

lines.en: We were all laughing, and it was a fun day. Also, there was that nice coffee truck.
lines.zh: 我們一直在笑，那天很好玩。而且那天還有很棒的咖啡車。

lines.en: Their dating icks or pet peeves.
lines.zh: 他們在約會中會倒胃口的點，或最受不了的事。

lines.en: Well, I would imagine yours is someone who's constantly on their phone.
lines.zh: 嗯，我猜你的是一直在滑手機的人。

lines.en: That is 100% true. Well done.
lines.zh: 百分之百正確，答得好。

lines.en: How about someone trying to force-feed you exotic food? They're like, "No, you have to try this."
lines.zh: 那硬要你吃奇怪食物的人呢？他們會說：「不行，你一定要吃吃看。」

lines.en: Oh, I've heard that. Yeah, it's horrible. So, yeah, you're right.
lines.zh: 喔，我聽過。對，那很可怕。所以你說對了。

lines.en: What's one of your biggest icks?
lines.zh: 你最受不了的事之一是什麼？

lines.en: Mine is if someone says they're really good at something, and then they're not.
lines.zh: 我的是有人說自己很擅長某件事，結果根本不行。

lines.en: Someone went, "Oh, Ben's really good at just reading the rules and translating something very quickly."
lines.zh: 有人說：「喔，Ben 很會看規則，能很快把東西講清楚。」

lines.en: He got them all wrong. We played a whole terrible version of the game that just didn't work.
lines.zh: 結果他全部講錯，我們玩了一個完全行不通的糟糕版本。

lines.en: Okay, I do have a pet peeve. People who are late and don't acknowledge it when they arrive.
lines.zh: 好，我確實有一件受不了的事：遲到了、到了卻不承認的人。

lines.en: Or are making you wait and don't say they're sorry. I think you should be aware.
lines.zh: 或是讓你等卻不道歉。我覺得應該要有自覺。

lines.en: Their love language. Quality time.
lines.zh: 他們的愛之語：精心時刻。

lines.en: I think yours would be acts of service.
lines.zh: 我想你的會是服務的行動。

lines.en: Honestly, even just the question of, "How can I help you feel better?" means a lot to me.
lines.zh: 老實說，光是有人問「我能怎麼幫你，讓你好過一點？」對我就很有意義。

lines.en: I'm like campaigning for everyone to put their phones down.
lines.zh: 我好像在發起運動，呼籲大家把手機放下。

lines.en: When people just don't have their phones and they're just present, you can just hang out.
lines.zh: 當大家都不拿手機、只是專心在當下，就能好好相處。

lines.en: You're like, "Oh, we're actively enjoying spending time together."
lines.zh: 你會覺得：「喔，我們是真心在享受一起相處的時光。」

lines.en: The romantic trope they think is the best.
lines.zh: 他們覺得最棒的浪漫情節套路。

lines.en: I feel like you would like surprising someone with a date.
lines.zh: 我覺得你會喜歡用約會給對方驚喜。

lines.en: This is exactly true. Oh my god, that is so good.
lines.zh: 完全正確。天啊，太厲害了。

lines.en: Supporting you. Because you're a lovely guy.
lines.zh: 支持對方。因為你是個很可愛的人。

lines.en: He wasn't necessarily doing anything, but he was just there.
lines.zh: 他不一定在做什麼，但他就是在那裡陪著。

lines.en: I remember you guys walking around that square at nighttime, and I was like, "Look how happy they are."
lines.zh: 我記得你們晚上在那個廣場散步，我就想：「看他們多開心。」

lines.en: He loves a slow burn. I do. I do love a slow burn.
lines.zh: 他喜歡慢熱的感情。我是，我真的很喜歡慢熱。

lines.en: Can I say fake dating? Fake dating.
lines.zh: 我可以說假裝交往嗎？假裝交往。

lines.en: The one thing that makes them break character in a scene and laugh.
lines.zh: 讓他們在戲裡忍不住出戲笑場的一件事。

lines.en: Rachel made me laugh so much. I'd have to bite the inside of my cheek.
lines.zh: Rachel 讓我笑到不行，我得咬住臉頰內側才忍得住。

lines.en: They were just sparking and improvising, and I was going, "Ah, they are funny." They just got funny bones.
lines.zh: 她們就一直即興、火花四射，我心想：「天啊，她們好好笑。」她們天生就有幽默感。

lines.en: A random topic they could each give a PowerPoint presentation on with no prep.
lines.zh: 他們不用準備就能做一場 PowerPoint 簡報的冷門主題。

lines.en: Well, apparently Shakespeare for you. That's pretty cool, isn't it?
lines.zh: 嗯，你的顯然是莎士比亞。滿酷的，對吧？

lines.en: I think I'd feel confident. I've been in enough of his plays, read enough of them, seen enough of them.
lines.zh: 我想我會很有自信。他的劇我演過夠多、讀過夠多、看過夠多了。

lines.en: What's amazing about him is we don't know much about him at all, other than he left his wife his second-best bed.
lines.zh: 他最神奇的是，我們對他幾乎一無所知，只知道他把第二好的床留給了太太。

lines.en: He wrote 32 plays in 12 years, which is insane.
lines.zh: 他 12 年內寫了 32 部劇，太瘋狂了。

lines.en: You gave me a lesson in McDonald's once. What was the lesson? That it's delicious.
lines.zh: 你有一次給我上了一堂麥當勞課。學到什麼？就是它很好吃。

lines.en: I love their hot fudge sundaes, although they don't have the little packet of peanuts anymore, and I miss those.
lines.zh: 我很愛他們的熱巧克力聖代，不過現在已經沒有那一小包花生了，我很懷念。

lines.en: A former co-star of theirs they'd love to work with again.
lines.zh: 他們很想再合作的前合作演員。

lines.en: Their go-to snack at craft services.
lines.zh: 他們在劇組點心桌最常吃的零食。

lines.en: Were you eating nuts? I did like a nut.
lines.zh: 你那時在吃堅果嗎？我確實喜歡吃堅果。

lines.en: There were some crackers. Didn't you have loads of crackers?
lines.zh: 有些蘇打餅。你不是吃了超多蘇打餅嗎？

lines.en: That was my fixation for week number one, and then I moved on quickly.
lines.zh: 那是我第一週的執念，然後我很快就換了。

lines.en: Go-to karaoke song. I have genuinely no idea. I don't even know what music you like.
lines.zh: 卡拉 OK 必點歌曲。我真的不知道，我連你喜歡什麼音樂都不知道。

lines.en: I would never attempt Stormzy as a karaoke song.
lines.zh: 我絕對不會在卡拉 OK 挑戰 Stormzy 的歌。

lines.en: The only one I have to say is "Easy" by the Commodores, just because I sang it once.
lines.zh: 我唯一能說的是 Commodores 的〈Easy〉，只因為我唱過一次。

lines.en: Mine lately has been "Silver Springs."
lines.zh: 我最近的是〈Silver Springs〉。

lines.en: I don't really fan girl. I keep it together. I don't fan girl out loud.
lines.zh: 我其實不太追星，我會保持鎮定，不會大聲尖叫。

lines.en: I really was so happy to go to her tour, because I love her album so much.
lines.zh: 能去她的巡迴演唱會我真的好開心，因為我超愛她的專輯。

lines.en: Their childhood celebrity crushes.
lines.zh: 他們童年時暗戀的明星。

lines.en: I know, Cameron Diaz. From The Mask.
lines.zh: 我知道，卡麥蓉狄亞。《摩登大聖》裡的。

lines.en: He doesn't have social, so there actually is no answer for this.
lines.zh: 他沒有社群帳號，所以這題其實沒有答案。

lines.en: If you had social, it would be full of, I believe, a lot of theater things. Some travel.
lines.zh: 如果你有社群，我相信會充滿很多劇場的東西，還有一些旅遊。

lines.en: Like cool hotels in Italy to go to.
lines.zh: 像是義大利值得去的很酷的飯店。

lines.en: You would interact with it, you would look at it and be like, "Interesting." And then your phone would take that information and give you more of it.
lines.zh: 你會和它互動、看了覺得「有意思」，然後手機就會拿這個資訊，推更多類似的給你。

lines.en: Oh, the algorithm is telling you, "Oh, you like this. You'll like more."
lines.zh: 喔，就是演算法在告訴你：「你喜歡這個，你會想看更多。」

lines.en: Right now it's a lot of nail designs. It's a lot of arts and crafts.
lines.zh: 現在有很多美甲設計，很多手作藝術。

lines.en: Perhaps some architectural things going on there, some house things, a lot of vintage fashion as well.
lines.zh: 也許還有一些建築、居家的東西，還有很多古著時尚。

lines.en: The book they think everyone should read at least once.
lines.zh: 他們認為每個人至少該讀一次的書。

lines.en: Their go-to coffee order. Black. Or an espresso.
lines.zh: 他們最常點的咖啡。黑咖啡，或是濃縮咖啡。

lines.en: Yours would be iced Americano. No. Iced latte with oat milk.
lines.zh: 你的會是冰美式。不是。是燕麥奶冰拿鐵。

lines.en: Lili, is there any British slang or phrase that Tom has taught you?
lines.zh: Lili，Tom 有教過你什麼英式俚語或說法嗎？

lines.en: The last text they sent you.
lines.zh: 他們傳給你的最後一則訊息。

lines.en: I said, "Did you get good sleep?" And you didn't answer me.
lines.zh: 我問：「你有睡好嗎？」結果你沒回我。

lines.en: I knew I was going to see you anyway.
lines.zh: 我知道反正會見到你。

lines.en: Their birthday. So, you're a Pisces, and I don't know what it means.
lines.zh: 他們的生日。所以你是雙魚座，但我不知道那代表什麼。

lines.en: It is March, yeah. It's the 15th of March.
lines.zh: 對，是三月。三月十五日。

lines.en: Okay, I was two days off.
lines.zh: 好，我差了兩天。

lines.en: No, we shot in July and August.
lines.zh: 不是，我們是七、八月拍的。

lines.en: Your eye color. Brown. Green.
lines.zh: 你的眼睛顏色。棕色。綠色。

lines.en: So, we both got a point there.
lines.zh: 所以這題我們都得分。

lines.en: 12 out of 21. I got eight.
lines.zh: 21 題答對 12 題。我答對 8 題。

lines.en: Look at you. You know a little more than the basics about your costars.
lines.zh: 看看你，你對合作演員的了解比基本多一點。

lines.en: You've gotten to hang out together a lot on set, so you know their work life pretty well, but you could do with getting to know them a little better outside of work.
lines.zh: 你們在片場常常相處，所以很了解對方工作時的樣子，但工作以外還可以再多認識一點。

lines.en: Time to hang out off set now.
lines.zh: 現在該在片場以外一起出去玩了。

lines.en: It's a funny thing, this, though, because I would say I know you.
lines.zh: 不過這很有趣，因為我會說我了解你。

lines.en: But I think I can hold about three or four birthdays in my head.
lines.zh: 但我想我的腦袋大概只記得住三、四個人的生日。

lines.en: Birthdays could be tricky.
lines.zh: 生日可能很難記。

lines.en: We would know how one another would react in a situation.
lines.zh: 我們會知道對方在某個情況下會有什麼反應。

lines.en: No, we went to the circus together. Cirque du Soleil.
lines.zh: 不，我們一起去看過馬戲團，太陽劇團。

lines.en: I've never seen Tom's face in such wonderment.
lines.zh: 我從沒看過 Tom 臉上有這麼驚奇的表情。

lines.en: How do you think you did? Fine. I feel like I know you. I feel like the test is rigged.
lines.zh: 你覺得自己表現得怎樣？還好。我覺得我了解你，我覺得這個測驗被動了手腳。

lines.en: We know each other. Thanks, BuzzFeed.
lines.zh: 我們很了解彼此。謝謝 BuzzFeed。

lines.en: Make sure to watch The Love Hypothesis on Prime Video, September 23rd.
lines.zh: 記得 9 月 23 日在 Prime Video 收看《愛情假說》。
